ticket.subject: Global search down
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

Search has returned no results for everyone in our account since 06:40 UTC, and a contact at another company sees the same.

Clearing caches did not help. Everything else in the app works, so we can still browse by hand.

This is blocking us right now, so we need help today. Please let us know when it will be fixed.

Kind regards,
Owen Delacroix

label_notes: clean outage (outage-search-down): a core feature is down for many customers while the rest of the app works, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
